description: Election Commission - R. Hariprasath was selected as the member of Batticaloa Municipal Council and M. M. M. Arif was selected as the member of Kaththankudy Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Batticaloa Municipal Council and Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including declarations of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignations, which falls under Election-related matters. The content focuses on electoral procedures and council member appointments rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
